column1: # Follow-up probes for an event's Subscribe (#724): what OpenVerse prints is in each probe's header and in note; the Book's or its API reference's expectation where it has one; Epic's outcome and lines in epic_outcome and epic_lines (UEFN 43.12, ++Fortnite+Release-43.12-CL-60598086, Use Verse VM, newVerseVm=true, 2026-11-19; - where not yet run), its error and the comparison in note. Known difference: the Verse VM varies the order of the subscribed functions between Signals, where OpenVerse keeps subscription order (subscribe-order).

column2: docs/api (event: "Subscribers ... are invoked only after every waiting task has been resumed")
column7: Same, as the API has it. OpenVerse: awaiter 1|handler 1|after signal|after wait.

column2: docs/api (event: "awaits registered during a signal ... are deliberately not resumed by that same signal")
column7: Same (Verse VM, 2026-11-19 09:43Z). A task started by a subscribed function that awaits the same event: resumed by the next Signal, not the running one. OpenVerse: handler 1|after signal 1|waiter 2|handler 2|after signal 2.
Same: a function cancelled by an earlier one during the Signal is skipped. OpenVerse: a 1|a 2|after.

Same (Verse VM, 2026-11-19 09:43Z). A subscription cancelled by an awaiter the Signal resumed: skipped by that Signal (it takes its list after the awaiters, subscribe-from-awaiter). OpenVerse: awaiter 1|after signal 1|after signal 2.
Same, as the Book has it. OpenVerse: rolled back|seen 1.
Same, as the API has it. OpenVerse: seen 1|cancelled twice|seen 1.
Same: event() (event(tuple()) on Epic) takes a function without parameters. OpenVerse: ping|after first|after second.
Same: each subscription is its own. OpenVerse: twice 1|twice 1|twice 2|after.

Unsettled for user code: Epic 3506 "Unknown identifier `sticky_event`" ("Did you forget to specify using { /Verse.org/Restricted }"), so a program cannot name it on 43.12. OpenVerse admits it: subscribed|sticky 2|after (no behaviour change).

column2: docs/api (event: "A Signal reaches exactly the tasks already suspended in Await and the callbacks currently subscribed")
column7: Same, as the API has it: a function subscribed by a called function is first called by the next Signal. OpenVerse: first 1|first 2|added 2|after.

column2: docs/api (event: "A Signal reaches exactly the tasks already suspended in Await and the callbacks currently subscribed")
column7: Same since #724's fix (OpenVerse printed no late 1 before): the Signal resumes its awaiters, then takes its list of functions, so one a resumed awaiter subscribed is called. The API's "callbacks currently subscribed" does not say when; OpenVerse had read it as at the start of the Signal. OpenVerse: awaiter 1|late 1|after signal 1|late 2|after signal 2.

column2: docs/14_concurrency.md, Subscribable Events (example 38, subscription order); docs/api (event: "invoked in a randomised order on every signal")
column7: Differs, a documented difference: the Verse VM's order varied between Signals in one run, as the API says; OpenVerse keeps subscription order (deterministic), and a program must not rely on the order. OpenVerse: a 1|b 1|c 1|a 2|b 2|c 2|a 3|b 3|c 3|after.
Same, as the Book has it. OpenVerse: rolled back|seen 0.
